title: The Postcards of Anderlecht
author: Yara Sandoval
blurb: Ada Underhill, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
